_comment: Reference values for lammps-msd-diffusion. Calibrated on x86_64 with compchem-bench/lammps-msd-diffusion:ci (LAMMPS 7Jan2022).
_calibration_note: LJ fluid 864 atoms, rho*=0.8442, T*=1.2, seed 31415, single-threaded: 5 oracle runs produced identical D=0.0720633 (deterministic). D tolerance +/-15% per spec. Consistency refit (log MSD, steps>=7000) tol 2%. L4: dump-recomputed MSD matches the log to dump print precision at the final frame (tol 1%) and the refit D to 5%.
